Buffer is explicitly not a canonical outbound/metrics provider. This is a separate legacy failure and not proof that portal 500 or provider-native LinkedIn/Instagram authorization is fixed.
prevention_rule: Retire only Netlify's legacy Buffer schedule. Preserve the callable evidence path and existing provider-native social, identity, CRM, outbound, Brain/Heartbeat and receipt pipelines without fallback or duplicate publishing. Provider status must be read back after production deploy.
implementation: Remove only export const config.schedule from netlify/functions/buffer-social-collect.mjs and add regression plus canonical documentation.
